history.subject: Cover-cocycle base change: a Cech cocycle on a finite localization cover of A pushes to one on the induced cover of A' (IsCoverCocycle.baseChange), the descent units correspond under tensorSqBaseChange (cocycleUnit_baseChange, by pi-ext on coordinate idempotents), and the descended Picard class is natural: pic_baseChange chains cocycleUnit_baseChange -> picClass_map -> picClass_baseChange to give picClass(gamma') = Pic.mapAlgebra A A' picClass(gamma). Plus FF bookkeeping (span_range_algebraMap_eq_top, faithfullyFlat_tensor). Cover face of the Cech-Picard dictionary naturality for Kleiman 2.5(1). Algebra/LocalizationCocycleBaseChange.lean, kernel-green, axiom-clean

Cech-Picard dictionary is natural in the affine scheme: toPic X (CechPic.map g L) = Pic.mapRingHom g.appTop (toPic Y L) for g : X -> Y affine (toPic_map, + toPic_mapAlgebra form). Route: product basic refinement of the pulled-back pointed cover, mapOverlap = appLE by uniqueness of algebra maps out of localizations, then pic_baseChange + picClass_map_refine + coboundary of cross-evaluations. Scheme face of the naturality campaign for Kleiman 2.5(1) etale separatedness; with alpha (picClass_baseChange) and beta (pic_baseChange) the dictionary square commutes end to end. Picard/CechPicToPicNaturality.lean, kernel-green, axiom-clean

Design: the (C1) delicate step decomposed as descent-in-stages — a single A-descent cocycle v on the composite cover A -> B -> Pi S_i whose tensorCollapse to P x_B P is the Zariski cocycle carries all fppf coherence; splice brick (epsilon2) = descendedCollapseEquiv in the landed equivDescended idiom, plus projection-units API (epsilon1) packaging unitsAppLE_snd_bijective with naturality in both arguments. Full unfolded assembly route for PicEtAff.unit_injective recorded. informal/c1-etale-separatedness-assembly.md

Descent in stages: for a tower A -> B -> P, an A-descent cocycle v on the composite cover collapses to a B-descent cocycle (tensorCollapse, IsDescentCocycle.collapse), the A-descended module base-changes to the B-descended module (descendedCollapseEquiv: B x_A descended(v) = descended(collapse v), equivDescended idiom), hence picClass_collapse: picClass(collapse v) = Pic.mapAlgebra A B picClass(v). This dissolves the 'one genuinely delicate step' of the (C1) ledger: all fppf coherence of the two-layer descent is carried by the single unit v. Descent/UnitDescentComposite.lean, kernel-green, axiom-clean

Projection-units API: units of the curve-product descend along the projection as a MulEquiv — unitsSndEquiv : units of Gamma(T,V) = units of Gamma((C x T).left, pr^-1 V) for affine V (packaging unitsAppLE_snd_bijective), with naturality in the open (unitsSndEquiv_unitsRestrict + symm form), naturality in the test object in full generality (unitsSndEquiv_naturality via snd_left_naturality: (C <| g).left >> snd = snd >> g.left), round-trips and the uniqueness lemma. The coherence workhorse for the fppf checks of the Kleiman 2.5(1) assembly. Picard/ProjectionUnits.lean, kernel-green, axiom-clean

Etale separatedness zeta1: the coherence seed — if a Cech Picard class L on C x Spec A restricts over B to a class pulled back from the base (p_B^* N), then the two base changes of N to B x_A B agree (cechPicMap_tensorInl_eq_tensorInr): both p-pull back to the same restriction of L, and prPullback_injective over Spec(B x_A B) closes. tensorInl/tensorInr in the doubleInl idiom + tensorInl_comp_ofId. Opens Picard/EtaleSeparatedness.lean, the future home of PicEtAff.unit_injective (Kleiman 2.5(1)); zeta2/zeta3 remain per worksheet. Kernel-green, axiom-clean

Design: zeta2 redesigned on the global-unit-correction route — never descend unit families along the projection; an arbitrary Cech witness theta for q1*N = q2*N is corrected into an Amitsur-coherent one by a single global unit: the coherence failure omega glues (sheaf condition) to a global unit of B x_A B x_A B, the upstairs discrepancy psi between p*theta and the lift's canonical telescope-exact comparison beta is a global unit of the curve-product, psi descends at V=top (brick 2/epsilon1), and injectivity of p* on global units forces omega = Amitsur-coboundary. All Cech work on affine schemes. Toolkit brick zeta2P specced. informal/c1-etale-separatedness-assembly.md
